steps.title: Do not take the first idea
steps.body: Before you play, find two or three real options, then compare them. The first idea is often the obvious one, and the obvious move is not always the best.

options: A move worth a closer look

steps.q: How many candidates should you look for?
steps.why: Enough to compare, few enough to check.

cards.prompt: How many candidate moves should you look for?
cards.why: Comparing options beats playing the first idea.
